title: What to know about Mass. Ballot Question 9, the effort to repeal a sweeping gun reform law
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Politics A yes vote would keep the sweeping gun reform law in place, while a no vote would repeal it.
When Chapter 135, “An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws,” was passed in 2024, gun control supporters celebrated, while Second Amendment advocates quickly started their fight to repeal it.
Now, nearly two years of organizing has brought Question 9, the Firearm Regulations Referendum, onto November’s ballot.
